patthana16.9:1.1: abyākataṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sappaṭigho dhammo-. na akusalo na sappaṭigho dhammo-. na kusalo na sappaṭigho ca na akusalo na sappaṭigho ca dhammo-. tīṇi.
patthana16.9:2.1: (kusalaṃ sappaṭighena, tīṇi. akusalaṃ appaṭighena, tīṇi. abyākataṃ appaṭighena, tīṇi. kusalaṃ appaṭighañca abyākataṃ appaṭighañca, tīṇi. akusalaṃ appaṭighañca abyākataṃ appaṭighañca tīṇi, paṇṇarasa.)
